commands.name: simple
commands.description: Turn Clean View on or off (on | off; no argument flips it)

tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Lay out every step of the job up front, before any other tool: 2 to 8 short plain-English step names in order, each under 40 characters, starting with a verb, with no file names, paths, commands or code. The first step starts right away.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report progress on the current step of the plan, by its exact name, with a percent from 0 to 100. Report 100 the moment a step finishes; the next step then starts by itself.
